## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      3 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Feb 18, 2026 - Aug 12, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Noor_75_, Jul 29, 2026, 1/5: "Most of us bought the app to have it forever. Now they’re hitting us with the premium suscription, and now ADS???? yall became so greedy"
            2. _kpiekut_, Jul 28, 2026, 1/5: "So I have spent some time over the years using the app on and off, unlocked some bits, decided to focus again only to be met with a sub paywall and all of my progress lost."
            3. _Antong.lv_, Jul 24, 2026, 1/5: "I paid 5 Euros for this app. As I understand, the features were meant to stay. Now, the app is free and all the features I used to have and actually PAID FOR got REMOVED or to precise are now hidden behind a second paywall. It’s not a lot of money but this is this a straight scam, sadly I really liked to use the app but this is plainly stupid. I hope I can get a refund from Apple"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Ads pressure** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Ads pressure.**
      1 recent review(s) mention ads pressure.
      Review window: Jul 9, 2026 - Jul 13, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users are noticing ad pressure. This can signal monetization friction and an opening for a cleaner competitor.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _w y_, Jul 9, 2026, 1/5: "paid for Forest plus and still got ads (not the optional ones for extra rewards)"
            2. _I just wanna read da Bible_, Jul 13, 2026, 3/5: "I really love this app (that I bought years ago), and as a graduate student I used to use it frequently. Recently, I needed a way to re-balance my time, and thought to re-download. Now it’s loaded with tons of ads and requests to purchase premium. It still works, but it’s a bit much and is irksome to use especially considering I paid for it (eg unskippable ad after most sessions?)"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      12 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Apr 11, 2026 - Aug 13, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Fulluphigh_, Aug 13, 2026, 1/5: "This app used to be so good. Now they somehow think that anyone is going to pay for their subscription service when every update the app gets buggier and buggier. If I close the app, it crashes. I don’t mean close it and open something else. I mean if I go back to the home screen or literally any other app. When the timer hits zero… Nothing happens. The widget stays on my Notification screen, stuck at zero, then the app will crash and I’ll get my trees, but the widget never goes away. The invite functionality forFocus together mode has never worked. Ever. In the history of the app. Why exactly would anyone pay money for this at this point I cannot fathom"
            2. _Puller75_, Aug 12, 2026, 1/5: "Wouldn’t let me create an account. When it finally did, somehow this was glitchy and wouldn’t work."
            3. _Keith Gold_, Jul 28, 2026, 1/5: "They recently updated the UI, this is how I know they do not use the app themselves, if it’s not broken why change it, please change the app to how it was before this terrible upgrade"
<!--/ir-theme-->
